titel: Yahya Abdul-Mateen: Being Grateful For The Good In Life

einzeiler: Yahya Abdul-Mateen II on acting, privacy, and finding peace away from the spotlight.
kurzfassung: Yahya Abdul-Mateen II reflects on his decade-long acting career, the intense anticipation before stepping on set, and his Tony-winning Broadway debut. He discusses growing up in a large New Orleans family, his shift from city planning to acting, and his passion for painting. Furthermore, he shares why he values solitude and protecting his private life from public view.
stichpunkte: Reflecting on a 10-year acting career spanning notable films, television series, and Broadway
Describing the heavy psychological anticipation and nervousness experienced right before a performance
Winning a Tony Award for Best Revival for the Broadway production of Topdog/Underdog
Transitioning from studying architecture and working in city planning in San Francisco to pursuing acting
Growing up as the youngest of six children in a close-knit New Orleans family that moved to Oakland
Explaining how acting serves as an escape from real-world anxieties and unexpected hardships
Finding personal balance through private hobbies such as painting and playing the golf course

kapitel.titel: The Reality of Acting and Set Life
Transitioning from City Planning to Acting
The IRL Bowl and Thoughts on Faith

clips.hook: Forgetting lines right as the curtain goes up on Broadway
clips.text: The guest recounts a terrifying moment during a theatrical run when he completely forgot his opening lines just as the stage curtain began to rise.

clips.hook: Giving up a steady career path to gamble on acting at Yale
clips.text: After getting laid off from a city planning position, the actor gave himself a strict three-year window to break into the industry before being accepted into Yale.

clips.hook: Trouble is always on its way, so there is no rush to meet it
clips.text: Life inevitably brings hardships and challenges down the road, making it pointless to stress over them before they actually arrive.

clips.hook: Leaving past relationships behind and moving straight forward
clips.text: When discussing youthful breakups and how family members interacted with past partners, the actor emphasizes a quick and decisive exit from the past.

beschreibung:
Emmy-award winning actor, Yahya Abdul-Mateen joins Angie Martinez to talk about his path to becoming an actor, advice he would give while dealing with "everyday problems,” and working with Mark Wahlberg on the newly released movie ‘By Any Means.’
